newsitem.title: UK: LME copper steady from kerb in late London.
newsitem.headline: LME copper steady from kerb in late London.

text.p: London Metal Exchange three months copper prices held the values seen at the firmer kerb close in quiet late inter-office activity on Wednesday.
Prices at one stage on Wednesday ran up to $2,083 per tonne - highest for more than two months - on spread tightness, speculative buying and expectations of further inventory falls.
But there was some stiff resistance and liquidation above $2,075 with the market also unsettled by a WBMS report that there may be substantial non-LME stocks in the Netherlands.
At the end of the kerb three months was at $2,060 for a $15 gain from Tuesday and it was bid by 1900 GMT when Comex closed at $2,061. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7729
